name: Corhazi Arsonist's Prepare ability grants stealth
notes: Corhazi Arsonist's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. The starting champion is pre-seeded with 1 preparation counter directly (normally only reachable via a separate preparation-counter-granting effect) so the Prepare activated ability's cost (remove 1 preparation counter from your champion, resolved by the ActivatedAbilityCost() switch in GameLogic.php) can actually be paid. Only the always-available 'gain stealth' half is covered; the onHit 'banish instead of die' replacement requires a real combat hit and is out of scope. FIXED implicit-REST bug: this ability's printed cost (Remove a preparation counter from your champion) has no [REST], but DoActivatedAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php) set Status=1 as an implicit [REST] for every static ability of an ALLY/CHAMPION/PHANTASIA not in the hard-coded $skipAutoRest list (trace: cardID=0ejcyuvuxn idx=0 static=1 before=2). The old expected_final_gamestate.txt silently pinned the rested state (Status 1); 0ejcyuvuxn is now in $skipAutoRest and the unit stays awake (Status 2), asserted explicitly.

rulesClauses: Remove a preparation counter from your champion: CARDNAME gains stealth until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Corhazi Arsonist's activated ability (printed cost: Remove a preparation counter from your champion; no [REST]) also RESTED the unit: DoActivatedAbility() sets Status=1 as the implicit [REST] cost unless the card id is in $skipAutoRest. Fix: add 0ejcyuvuxn to $skipAutoRest (same fix as Tristan, Shadowdancer's Redirect).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivatedAbility() $skipAutoRest list / implicit REST for static unit abilities
